submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE independently redrawn full-body animation frame on genuine transparent RGBA, native square at least1024x1024. Image1 is the current target: lock head, face, hair, upper-body root, scale, camera, both arms/hands, full-length bamboo bow and string, right-shoulder quiver, palette and costume details EXACTLY. Only redraw pelvis-to-boots and locally necessary shorts overlap. Image2 is same character's established support-foot chain; identify the same support leg, do not copy its pose. Image3 is approved primary painting-style reference only: bright clean rounded ivory/jade/gold hand-painted Daoist chibi; no UI reproduction. Exactly two connected legs, natural hip-knee-ankle, no everted ankle, toes align with movement rather than outward splay. Anatomical LEFT hand grips full long bow, RIGHT hand EMPTY; no new weapon or arrow. NO floor, shadow, text, particles, checkerboard or backdrop. No translating whole character, root recentering, bbox zoom, crop, mirror, interpolation, or copied repeated pose. Redraw joints individually. This16frame run uses one SAME support foot continuously grounded for8frames, then the other foot for8; each ground-position stage has2distinct poses. The support foot must actually take weight with clear sole/forefoot contact, not merely be the lowest dangling foot. The other swing foot must remain clearly lifted. Ground progression follows the running axis; no outward lateral steps. WEST profile facing screenLEFT. Travel axis is horizontal left. RIGHT is the same established support leg from image2; LEFT is the other swing leg. Frame13/16: support now behind pelvis, loaded late stance, first pose of this pair. First late-stance pose: body ahead of support, knee naturally extends with firm whole-sole/forefoot pressure. On1024canvas the supporting sole stays at the reference floor band abouty970, centered approximatelyx550. Heel/forefoot contact is read from anatomy, not a hanging pointed boot. Shoe toe pointsLEFT. At stages1/2 use broad flat sole, heel down. At final stage forefoot at same floor, heel naturally rises modestly. Swing knee advances toward screenLEFT and shoe is lifted. Do not leave the other forward foot planted. IMPORTANT: keep the rear supporting ankle directly below the rear edge of the shorts, only slightly screenRIGHT of pelvis. Do not stretch the rear leg out to the far-right frame edge; the planted boot should remain below the character around x550–585, with a soft natural knee. Keep image1's upper silhouette untouched.
